full_prompt_en: A square, minutely detailed decorative painting places a circular garden vignette at the center of a solid black ground. The round image is packed with blue-green foliage, ivory blossoms, warm ochre trunks, patterned earth, and white birds. Near the upper center, a rough pale-gold trunk rises between large cream roses, whose layered petals stand out against dark leaves. A white bird with spread wings crosses the upper-right cluster, while another tall white bird stands just right of center with a long neck, fine beak, and layered trailing feathers. Smaller pale birds gather near the lower left and right edges among roots and low flowers. The central tree branches outward so leaves and blossoms fill much of the upper arc, while the lower arc reveals tan roots, blue patterned patches, and small coral-red floral points. Every leaf, feather, petal, and textured ground segment is rendered as a distinct decorative mark. Dark blue and teal areas carry tiny gold-like flecks; ivory highlights separate the brightest birds and blooms from the densely worked background. The round composition ends abruptly at a clean circular border, with unbroken black corners outside it. Illumination feels even and jewel-like rather than tied to a single natural source: white forms glow softly, warm earth rises through cool foliage, and small shadows stay tucked into the overlapping details. The surface suggests fine brushwork and ornamental inlay, with crisp edges and no empty space inside the circle. The overall composition is sumptuous and contained, using a black surround to intensify the intricate ivory, turquoise, gold, and rust-colored miniature world.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节极密的装饰绘画把一枚圆形花园小景置于纯黑背景中央。圆景挤满蓝绿色枝叶、象牙白花朵、暖赭树干、花纹地面与白鸟。靠近上方中央，一截粗糙浅金色树干从大朵乳白玫瑰间升起，层层花瓣在深叶前突出。一只白鸟张翼越过右上方花簇；另一只高大的白鸟站在中央偏右，长颈、细喙和层叠垂羽清楚可见。较小的浅色鸟聚在左右下边缘的树根与低花间。中央树木向外分枝，让叶与花填满上方圆弧；下方弧线则露出棕褐根系、蓝色花纹色块和小珊瑚红花点。每片叶、羽、花瓣与纹理地面都被画成独立装饰笔迹。深蓝和青绿区域带细碎金色般斑点；象牙白高光把最亮鸟与花从密集背景中分开。圆形构图在干净的边界处骤然结束，外侧四角保持连续黑色。照明均匀且像宝石发亮，而非来自单一自然光源：白色形态柔和泛光，暖土地穿过冷枝叶，小阴影藏在交叠细节里。表面近似精细笔绘与装饰镶嵌，边缘清楚，圆内几乎没有空白。整体构图丰盛而收束，以黑色环绕加强这个象牙白、青绿、金色和铁锈色微型世界的复杂度。
style_prompt_en: The decorative painting builds a densely worked luminous field inside a sharply bounded shape against deep black negative space. Ivory, turquoise, mineral blue, antique gold, and small rust-red accents interlock through fine repeated marks. Crisp contours separate nested layers, while tiny flecks and patterned strokes keep each colored passage tactile. Bright forms are distributed in a measured rhythm among dark blue-green masses, so the eye moves through many details without losing the overall structure. Illumination is even and jewel-like, with localized glints and compact recess shadows rather than broad natural cast shadows. The composition feels like intricate inlay or miniature painting, balancing exhaustive internal ornament with a simple surrounding void. Its richness comes from the close spacing and precise color contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰绘画在深黑留白前，把细密加工且发亮的色场收进一道边界清楚的形状。象牙白、青绿、矿物蓝、古金和小片铁锈红通过反复细笔迹互相嵌合。清晰轮廓分开套叠的层次，细点和花纹笔触让每段颜色都有触感。明亮形态有节奏地分布于深蓝绿色大块之间，让视线穿过许多细节仍不失整体结构。照明均匀而宝石般明亮，以局部闪光和紧凑凹影为主，不依赖宽阔自然投影。构图近似复杂镶嵌或细密画，用内部穷尽的装饰平衡外侧简洁空场。丰富感来自紧密间距与精准色彩对比。
theme_en: White birds and blossoms in a circular jeweled garden vignette
theme_zh: 圆形宝石般花园小景中的白鸟与白花
name: Raqib Shaw
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
